tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// shakranturekhānāmabitsarīyāssaṃshayathanadyaprashnottarabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// rnam par dpyod ldan nas som nyi'i gnas kyi gsung lan dbang po'i zla ris zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄// gauṇyaḥdashabalāḥbalakāyapūrṇoḥsmṛtyubagatikāruṇadzātritedza/ nādena.abhayān+yarutābhibhūyaṃsidhāyabhagawāṃmunishyakyanamraḥ ༄༅// stobs bcu'i yon tan kun gyi lus rtsal rdzogs// dran pa nyer gnas thugs rjes ral pas brjid// bsnyengs bral nga ros sgra gzhan zil gyis gnon// bcom ldan thub pa shākya seng ger 'dud// kun mkhyen ma lus bskyed pa'i yab gyur kyang*// bgrang bya bcu drug son pa'i lang tsho 'chang*// 'dri dang lan ldon spobs pa'i rtser phyin la// khengs pa'i skyon bral 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi lugs bzang la// chos dang chos min dpyod pa'i blo ldan gyis// dris pa dris lan gang dag nges phyogs nas// 'phrin snyan 'phrin du shod la cung zad dgongs// yul gyi gnad la bsnun pa'i 'phangs skyen gyis// drang po'i sgro ldan btang bas 'bigs pa 'dis// dka' tshegs chung ngus rang bzor goms pa'i sems// tshig 'jam tsher ma'i reg bya 'dzin yang srid// 'on te gzhung nas bshad dang gong ma dag /phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa lhur blang na// dka' yang nyams su blangs pas phan yon dang*// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i dgos pa yod// zhes mchod par brjod cing dngos po nges par bstan pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir gra'u bla brang nas mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam rol bla ma kun dga' rab brtan pa nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bstan pa rnam par dag pa yun ring du gnas pa'i dgongs pas/ da lta'i skabs kyi phyag len phal cher la dogs gnas shar ba rnams/ slad char 'di bzhin btub bam mi btub kyi/ bka' 'dri phebs nang 'di ltar gnang ste/ dri ba dang por/ kye rdor sbyin sreg skabs nus na gzhal yas khang bskyed gsungs pa 'di la dur khrod bskyed dam mi bskyed ces phebs par/

gsung lan ni/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bsgom pa brtan byed kyi sngags brjod pa'i bar dang*/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la sogs nas/ 'byung bzhi bar do'i shes pa bcas pa'i rgyu las gzhal yas khang dur khrod bcas bskyed pa da lta'i phyag len la yod pa ltar ram/ yang na srung 'khor gyi dbus su bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sogs nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad sogs mdun bskyed ltar brjod cing*/ yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar sogs gdan dang bcas bskyed pa yin la/ mi nus na/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs padma sogs kyis bskyed pa rgyas bsdus de gsum gang mos byed pa yin lags/ dri ba gnyis pa/ kye rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi til bsogs dus lha sngags kyi bskang ba yin nam til sngags yin lags/ ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ bsnyen pa gang la song ba de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'bul bar bshad pas/ 'dir bsnyen pa'i gtso bo rtsa sngags aṣṭa bzhi 'bum bsags pa kho na'i dbang du byas tshe/ kha skong rtsa sngags la grangs bsags mi thub pas/ til sngags la grangs bzung ba yin gyi/ gzhan du rtsa sngags dang snying po de wa pi tsu la'ang*/ rab 'bum phrag bco lnga/ de ltar ma byung na'ang rtsa sngags kyi grangs mnyam bzhi 'bum bzlas pa zhig yin na/ snying po kho nas kha skong bsags chog pa yin te/ dper na/ 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum ka la bsnyen pa bsags pa zhig gis/ hrīḥṣṭī kho na la grangs bsags pa bzhin no// 'on kyang 'dir dogs gnas yod pa/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i mjug tu dril bu dkrol zhing*/

kol la i raṭaṭhi sogs rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba smon lam bcas 'di dkyus su mi gsal yang ma chad pa gal che/ de rjes gshegs gsol sogs bya ba yin no// dri ba gsum pa/ kye rdor dbang chu'i skabs su swa bhā wa sogs kyis sngags gsum gyi dag pa dran pa bya'o zhes zer ba zhig 'dug pa dgos mi dgos/ dgos na dngos gzhi thams cad la dgos sam dngos gzhi dang po la yin/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ sta gon gyi mdang nub mor nyal ba'i rnal 'byor 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal nas/ tho rangs sad pa na/ stong nyid kyi ngang nas chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis/ kye rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis langs nas/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod cing nga rgyal bya ba 'di thams cad kyis grub na langs ma thag bya dgos shing*/ khyad par slob dpon rang nyid kyis ma chad pa gal che/ gzhan rnams la ni mi dgos te ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gzhan ltar byas pas btub bo// dri ba bzhi pa/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kye'i rdo rje'i 'pho lung de gang zag mchog dman gang la byed kyang chog gam mi chog ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ kye rdo rje'i 'pho ba 'di gang zag rab lam 'bras bu dang bcas gdams ngag gi khrid kyis rgyud smin cing*/ rgyun du lam dus kyi bsgom bzlas lhur len pa/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la goms 'dris byas pa zhig gam/ yang na kye rdo rje'i phyi nang gi dbang bzhi thob nas de'i bsgom bzlas gtso bor byed pa zhig la gdams pa 'bogs chog la/ de bzhin du mkha' spyod sogs kyi lam la goms 'dris dang*/ 'pho ba'i gdams ngag thob cing goms 'dris yod pa zhig gtso bor bya/ de bzhin du thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid sogs la nyams len byed pa rnams la'ang de'i rigs 'gre/ gang zag blo dman rnams phal pa'i rigs la 'od dpag med kyi 'pho ba'am/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi nyal 'pho'am/ yang na thugs rje chen po 'di gangs can 'gro ba kun gyi lha skal yin pa dang*/

ngag tu'ang yig drug zlos pa mang du 'byung ba dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'ang shas che yod srid pa sogs kyis de'i 'pho ba byas pas chog par sems so// dri ba lnga pa/ rdo rje gur gyi srung 'khor skabs hūm̐ mdzad bskyed tshul dang*/ rab gsal snang ba las gnod pa phyir bzlog bsgom bzlas/ 'di phyogs la rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad bskyed nas bzlas pa bcas byed srol 'dug pas 'di la bka' lan gsal bar zhu/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ gur gyi srung 'khor la dbus su hūm̐ mdzad bskyed pa ni bsrung ba'i skabs yin pas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ de nas khro bo'i dbang po rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad de/ dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tshun chad bsrung bar bsams te/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa zhes pas brtan par byas nas rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad kyi lto ba'i nang ngam zhu ba las byung ba'i chos 'byung bskyed pa sogs ni bsrung ba yin pas/ 'di la phyir bzlog gi sngags bzla ba dang 'khor lo g.yon skor bya ba sogs ni mi rung ste/ 'di srung ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro// dri ba drug pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur la slob ma grangs nges med pa 'di'i don gang lags/ ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang la grangs nges med pa ni/ slob dpon sā dhū pu ṭas/ dbang bskur ba'i slob ma gcig gam gnyis sam mang po yang rung ste/ zhes gsungs pa 'di rnal 'byor bla med la dgongs pa yin gyi/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi lung don ni/ bya rgyud la dgongs pa yin zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo*// zhes mkhas grub bu ston gyis de tsam zhig gsung ba dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba la/ slob ma grangs nges med pa 'di nam zhig nas byung ba yin ma nges kyang*/ dpyad na/ dus 'khor dbang chog rgyas che ba dang*/ phreng ba'ang dkyil 'khor mang po'i dbang bskur 'di dag gi grangs nges kho na byas na rgyun chad kyi dogs pas cung zad gu yangs su btang ba yin nam snyam ma gtogs/

gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum// lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam// nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar// zung du ma gyur slob ma bzung*// de bas lhag pa'i slob ma ni// yongs su bzung ba mi shis so// zhes gsungs pa 'di/ spyi rgyud ni/ sngags kyi cho ga spyi la khyab byed du bzung nas/ rgyud sde gong 'og kun gyi dbang bskur zur pa thams cad la grangs nges 'di ltar mdzad pa yin pas/ da ltar phyag len la'ang de ltar du mdzad pa dgongs ltar lags/ dri ba bdun pa/ phreng ba slob ma dbang bskur gyi dkyil 'khor lha ngo bstan dus 'joms rdor gyi skabs su rgyas bsdus gnyis bshad 'dug pas/ bsdus pa 'di dkyil 'khor 'og ma rnams la sbyar chog min gyi gsal kha mi 'dug pas chog gam mi chog ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ phreng ba'i lha ston gyi skabs rgyas bsdus gnyis las bsdus pa'i gzhal yas khang brten pa ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar rung mod/ gzhan brten pa lha gdan dang bcas pa ni/ sgrub thabs tha dad rang rang gi dkyus nas bshad pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs rgyas pa'am/ bsdus pa lha'i sku mdog dang mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang rung ba bshad pa ltar gang mos byar rung*/ dri ba brgyad pa/ kun rig la da nang sgrub thabs phog gcig byed nas de nas sgrub mi dgos pa'i nyin re la dbang gang 'gro byed 'dug pa 'di yi don gang lags/ ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ kun rig cho ga'i bdag bum mdun bskyed sgrub mchod/ gtor ma gtang ba/ bdag 'jug gi dbang blang ba/ bdag sgrub cing bzlas pa bya ba rnams sngon du btang nas/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga tshun chad la sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas pa/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba mtha' rten bcas dang*/ rjes gtso bos maṇḍal lus longs spyod dbul ba bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba de lta bu ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams las dbang bskur ba lan mang thob myong la/

de man chad kyi dbang la bdag mdun sgrub 'jug sogs slob dpon la dgos pa'i bya ba gang dang yang ma 'brel bar slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa'i dbang kho na grangs brtsegs nas bskur ba de lta bu ni sngon chad ci yang ma thob cing*/ dbang thob pa'i phan yon sogs kyang ci yod ma shes mod/ rnam par dpyad na nyi shu rtsa lnga tshun gyi slob ma dbang bskur ba la/ de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum tshang ba zhig bskur dgos mod/ de ltar ma yin pa bdag mdun sgrub mchod 'jug pa tshar gcig byas pa de'i steng nas/ dbang dang po de'i cho ga phyag len ma nor ba zhig byas yod na/ des smin byed dbang gi go chod la/ dbang gnyis pa man chad slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad dor nas/ slob ma'i bya ba kho na grangs bskyed nas bskur ba de 'dra lo paṇa mkhas grub chen po rnams sam/ bod yul gyi'ang bla ma mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug su zhig gi phyag len las byung ba de/ da lta kho rang gi bar gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa gang dang gang las ji ltar byung*/ dbang de thob pas ma smin pa smin byed du 'gyur ba dang*/ dbang de thob nas bsgom bzlas bsnyen sgrub sogs byas na/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ngam mi 'byung*/ dbang des bla ma gong ma'i bstan pa dang phrin las kyi rgyun la phan nam gnod par 'gyur/ zhes dris na/ smra rgyu yod dgos la/ med na rang bzo'i dbang de phan pa med cing dam pa'i phrin las la gnod par 'gyur ba'i dbang de bskur mkhan dang zhu mkhan gnyis ka la dka' tshegs che ba tsam ma gtogs dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ dper na/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo sogs bzhon ma'i rigs la/ sngon du rtsa chu la sogs pa'i bza' btung legs par byin nas/ dus su bab pa na 'o ma 'jo ba ni kun la dar mod/ de phyin chad rtsa chu sogs ci yang ma byin par mug skam byas pa'i bzhon ma las nam dgos dus su 'o ma yang nas yang du bzho rgyu 'byung ba srid dam ma yin/

de mi srid na bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom bzlas dang mdun gyi lha bskyed mchod bstod sogs ci yang mi dgos pa slob ma la dbang bskur yang yang byed du btub pa ga la srid de de gnyis mtshungs pa'i phyir/ sa skya pa dang ngor pa'i bla ma gong ma mkhas shing grub pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa da lta'i bar gang dag byon pa rnams kyi lam 'bras 'chad pa'i skabs kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang dang lam dbang sogs bskur ba na'ang*/ snga dro slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa ma tshang ba med pa bsgrubs nas/ slob ma la bya ba dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba mtha' rten bcas dang*/ rjes dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod brtan bzhugs bkra shis bcas mdzad zin pa dang*/ yang phyi dro'i dbang tshan la'ang de ltar du mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bskur thams cad la'ang sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba mtha' rten bcas dang*/ mjug mchod bstod brtan bzhugs bcas pa'i cho gas grwa tshogs mang po la dbang tshan mang po gshar ba mdzad pa de rnams kyang sla chos de 'dra ma dgongs pa'i skyon can du khas len nam ji ltar smra/ dper na/ 'jig rten pa'i bya ba la'ang*/ dpyid ka zhing la chu lud bran zhing sa bon gdab pa dang*/ zhing sa gshin par bya ba sogs so nam tshul bzhin byas te/ ston kar lo thog brnga ba lan gcig byas mthar/ slar sa bon gdab pa sogs so nam ci yang mi dgos par btsas ma yang yang brnga rgyu 'byung srid dam/ des na de lta bu dbang des rang gzhan dang bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa med pa'i khar gnod tshab che ba'i rgyur 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// sangs rgyas bstan la ma phan yang*// rnam pa kun tu gnod mi bya// zhes dang*/ blun po snying phod can gyis kyang*// 'dul ba'i cho ga brgal ma nus// gsang sngags can gyi cho ga la// blun po rnams kyi rang dgar spyod// zhes gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i dbang des smin byed kyi go chod pa lta zhog

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs la'ang snga dro bdag mdun 'jug pa bcas lan gcig sngon du song nas byin rlabs dbang tshan mang po gshar ba dang*/ phyi dror yang slob dpon gyi bya ba lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i byin rlabs tshar mang po gshar ba de yang phyis su sla chos kyi srol ngan la shor ba 'dra bas tshan gnyis pa man gyi byin rlabs des go chod min ji ltar zhes rang gzhan gyi dpyod ldan rnams the tshom gyi gzhi byed de/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang ma 'brel ba'i phyir/ dri ba dgu pa/ rjes gnang la yang gong gi kun rig dang 'gros mthun pa zhig byed 'dug pas chog gam mi chog ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ tshe sgrub lta bu brgya tshar bsags dgos pa'i rigs dang*/ khrus mang po bsags dgos pa mo brtags sogs las shar ba rnams la ni/ bdag mdun lan gcig bsgrubs nas/ dbang khrus rgyas pa gcig gi mjug tu bsdus pa zhig la grangs bsags byed srol 'dug mod/ rjes gnang gzhan la slob dpon gyis bya ba bdag mdun sgrub pa lan gcig sngon du btang nas/ slob ma la bya ba'i rjes gnang tshar grangs bsags pa kun rig gi g.yo sgyu'i dbang ltar byed pa de 'dra ni grub mtha' gzhan gyi shan shor ba yin gyi/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras sogs grwa sa chen po dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la byed pa gtan mi srid/ gal te kun rig dang rjes gnang gi rigs rnams tshar grangs mang po bsags dgos na/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum tshang ba tshar re bzhin bsags na de la phan yon dang byin rlabs 'byung ba gdon mi za bas/ gnang mkhan dang zhu mkhan gnyis kas de bzhin mdzad na legs te bla ma gong ma'i phrin las rgyun la mi gnod pa dang bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du mi 'gro ba'i phan yon yod pa'i phyir/ dri ba bcu pa/ slob dpon gcig gi slob ma la/ dper na gshed dmar dang*/ lo gyon gnyis kyi rjes gnang dgos na mchod gtor dang tshom bu kha gnyis byed nas/

thog mar gshed dmar mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ yang lo gyon ma'i mchod pa byin rlabs nas mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ slob ma thog mar gshed dmar rjes gnang dang*/ de rjes lo gyon rjes gnang byed nas rjes chog la yang de'i rigs 'gres byed pa 'di 'thad dam mi 'thad lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ rjes gnang gi lha gnyis ra ma lug gam nya dang nyungs ma bsres nas 'tshong ba lta bu de 'dra bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa'i brtan pa thob pa'i grub thob kyi spyod pa rnams la bya ba ci yang rtsed 'jo lta bus bskur ba de 'dra 'ga' re yod las che mod/ deng sang gi dus kyi gang zag mchog 'bring bar ma kun gyis kyang gshin rje gshed lta bu la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma la bya ba gnyis ka rjes mchod bstod gshegs gsol bcas grub nas/ ri khrod ma lta bu'i rjes gnang gsar du bsgrubs nas slob ma la sbyin pa bcas tshang ba re byas na legs pa mngon te/ rgyu mtshan da lta sa ngor gyi slob dpon mkhas grub kyi go sar bzhugs pa thams cad kyis kyang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho snar thang brgya rtsa sgrol ma nyer gcig sogs thams cad la'ang lha re re bzhin bdag mdun bsgrubs nas/ slob ma la rjes gnang sbyin pa rjes kyi bya ba bcas re re bzhin mdzad pa 'di'i shes shing de ltar mdzad pa legs mod/ gzhan du spel mar mdzad pa de la rnam par dpyad na/ lha sngon ma'i bdag mdun sgrub thabs la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i 'ching ba bzlas pa bcas byas nas/ slar de'i dmigs pa dor nas lha gzhan gyi skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ bdag mdun sgrub pa bzlas pa bcas byas/ slar yang da dung lha gzhan gyi bdag mdun sgrub pa sogs byas mthar/ slob ma bos nas lha gsum gyi dang po de'i bdag mdun skad cig dran rdzogs su gsal btab nas slob ma la rjes gnang sbyin btub na/

sngar gyi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa de'i dmigs pa rnams sngar nas dor zin la/ da lam skad cig dran rdzogs kyis bdag mdun gsal gdab pa des slob ma la rjes gnang sbyin btub na/ sngar skyabs sems sogs nas bdag mdun yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas bsgrub pa de don med du song bar thal te mkho dgos ma byung ba'i phyir/ gal te de lta bu'i rjes gnang des rjes gnang gi go chod na/ kha sang rjes gnang gi lha gcig bsgrubs pa des/ kha sang dang de ring dang sang nyin lta bu'i zhag grangs mang por slob ma'i bya ba kho na byed chog par thal te/ rnal 'byor gzhan gyis bar chod pa dang*/ gnyid dang zhag gi bar chod pa gnyis la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ des na rjes gnang re re bzhin du bsgrub cing slob ma la gnang ba sogs re re nas mdzad cing*/ rjes mchod bstod gshegs gsol byas mthar/ tshom bu'ang brje ba'am mi nus na kha sab tsam byas na phyag len legs par mngon no// de ltar ma yin na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa lta bu sbrel te gnang ba'i tshe snga dror lha bdun tsam gyi bdag mdun bsgrubs nas/ phyi dro slob ma la lha bdun gyi rjes gnang rim pa bzhin sbyin pa la'ang bla ma slob ma gnyis kas lha so so'i dmigs pa re re bzhin skad cig res gsal 'debs nus pa'ang dka' na rjes gnang tshad ldan 'byung ba ga la 'gyur snyam mo// dri ba bcu gcig pa/ lung gi skabs su sgom lung 'bogs lugs gang lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ sgom lung 'bogs pa kho bos sngar thob pa la ni/ 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang gi mthar gnad bcu gcig po nyams su len tshul slob dpon gyis ngag nas bshad cing bsgom tshul 'bogs pa dang*/ gser chos rdo rje khyung khra la'ang sgom lung 'bogs tshul tsam mchis la/ de las gzhan ni ma thos shing*/ 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma lta bu'i byin rlabs la ni rig gtad ces bya ste/

de rigs rnams ni bya rgyud las 'byung ba lags so// dri ba bcu gnyis pa/ spar kha sogs stabs kyi shi ba'i phung pos lo lon rgyu yod tshul byed 'dug pa de'i rgyu mtshan gang lags/ ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ shi ba'i phung po nam shi ba'i lo de ma gtogs par lo grangs ji tsam song yang lo len rgyu med pa brtsi/ de'i don ni kung kung sogs ro sgul bskyod mi nyan pa rnams lo shas bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags/ dri ba bcu gsum pa/ de dag gi skabs su sngar lo nas phung po la gnas yig dang chas 'jug sogs btags nas phyir lo me sbar ba ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos pa zhig byed 'dug pa 'di 'gal lam mi 'gal/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ phung po la dbang bskur te/ mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba'i skabs/ rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni// sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur// lha yi gzugs su brtags nas kyang*// mchod rten dbus su bzhag par bya// zhes bya ba'i don ni/ shi ba'i phung po gang du bzhag pa der sngar lo nas rab kun rig gi dbang bskur nas rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa de'am/ yang na skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa de la/ gnas rnams su 'dogs yig btags shing byin gyis brlabs pa byed pa de ni mi 'gal ba ma zad shin tu legs te/ sbyong rgyud kyi sdig sbyong gi sgo dgu las/ gtsang khang du bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba zhes pa'i don yin pa dang*/ phyir lo lta bur sbyin sreg byed pa ni/ ro bsreg te sdig pa sbyang ba zhes bya ba yin pas de ltar byed pa byung ba'ang legs/ dri ba bcu bzhi pa/ kun rig ro sreg skabs 'di phyogs la thab dang slob dpon rnams steng 'og lta bu 'gyangs nas 'don pa'i lugs 'dug pa 'di 'thad dam mi 'thad lags/ ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ kun rig sogs ro sreg gang yin gyi skabs su bsreg khang shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba yod pa'i nang yin na/

de'i nang gi rang kha shar phyogs su lta ba sogs 'grigs pa byung na legs mod/ khang pa dog pa sogs la ni du ba dang me tshegs sogs kyis cung zad 'gyang ba dang khang pa gzhan dang steng shod lta bur byung yang chog par byed dgos pa 'dug ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sgrub pa po des sngar swa bhā wa sogs kyi sngags kyis phyi nang gi chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyangs pas/ da ltar gyi snang ba'i gyang dang rtsig pa sogs mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas thab khung sogs bskyed dgos pa yin pas/ de ltar shes pa'i ngor ni mi gnod pa yin la/ da ltar tha mal gyi snang ba la bden 'dzin can gyi slob dpon zhig yin na phung po'i rtsar bsdad kyang bsreg khang sogs kyi zung rngus kyang mi gnod pa ci zhig yod/ dri ba bco lnga pa/ kun rig sgrub dkyil bdag 'jug yan tshar ba'i bdag mdun sgrub pa'i bzlas pa brtan bzhugs tshar ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la gdan drangs nas khrus chog byas nas slar rjes chog sogs byed 'dug pas/ dkyil 'khor gdan drangs chog gam mi chog ces phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod brtan bzhugs bcas byas pa de/ slar rjes chog ma byas bar du gzhan du khur mi rung ste/ dkyil 'khor bshig pa'i nyes pa 'byung ba dang*/ sngar brtan par bzhugs pa'i gsol gdab byas zin pa'i phyir/ khrus chog byed sar dkyil 'khor yod mi dgos te/ mchog khrus byed pa'i las kyi rdo rjes bum pa me long sogs bsnams te/ dkyil 'khor mdun du 'od khrus byed/ de'i tshe slob dpon sogs kyis ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod cing*/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus chu de bum par blugs te 'ongs pa des dman khrus byed pa yin pas des 'thus/ phung po la dbang bskur sogs byed na'ang dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs byas ltar bzhugs pa'i mdun du dbang bskur ba'i 'dun pa byed pa dang*/

thag nye ring dang rtsig pa sogs kyi rnam rtog mi byed pa ni sngar ro bsreg gi skabs su ji skad bstan pa'i don ltar dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang po bskyed pa'i tshe na'ang oṃ shas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ bha zhes pas ston pas lha gnas su rgyud gsungs pa'i dus kyi thar ba'i 'dra 'bag dang mthun par 'byung bzhi ri rab dkyil 'khor bcas bskyed gzhi rgya dpangs ma chung tsam bskyed dgos pa brtags pas kyang shes pa'i phyir/ dri ba bcu drug pa/ cha gsum gtor ma glo bur du mang du btang dgos 'dug pas bdag bskyed dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na gang 'thad lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ cha gsum 'phral du btang tshe/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i sogs nas/ lce lag byin rlabs dang*/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sogs nas/ oṃ badzra tu ṣya hoḥzhes pa'i bar kun rig ltar khro bo bskyed/ de nas oṃ badzra yakṣa sogs nas/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas phyogs skyong 'byung po la 'bul ba dang*/ bgegs gtor phyi rol du dor ba'i bar bya/ slar yang tshar mang du btang dgos na gtor ma sab bran dang byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la/ sngar spyan drangs pa'i phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas gandhaṃ bar dang*/ oṃ aṇḍa ya sogs gtor sngags lan gsum dang*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can sogs nas 'phrin bcol gyi bar dang*/ 'byung po la'ang oṃ sarba lo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas gandhe'i bar dang*/ oṃ de wa nā ga sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ 'byung po gang dag sogs 'dod gsol bcas byas la/ bgegs gtor la bgegs dgug pa dang*/ gtor ma bsngo ba/ phyir dor ba bcas tshar re bzhin bya/

de lta bu la grangs bsags/ mthar sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis mthus// sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod pa'o// dri ba bcu bdun pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg skabs rigs bdag mi bskyod pa mi chog kye rdor ltar gyi rnam snang dgos zer 'dug pa gang 'thad lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa 'byung ba bzhin du rgyas pa dang dbang drag thams cad la mi bskyod pa kho nar byed pa las rigs gzhan bsgyur mi dgos/ zhar la/ 'jigs byed rdul tshon gyi khrag zhag ri mo gri gug dbyibs can zhes 'byung ba gri gug so gyen du bstan pa'i rnam pa lta bu bri srol mchis/ dri ba bco brgyad pa/ a mes lags kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod cho ga la bdag bskyed ngor lugs mdzad 'dug pas 'thad dam mi 'thad lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ mkha' spyod cho ga a mes lags kyis mdzad pa'i 'gor/ ngor lugs sgrub thabs sogs rang gi blo la gang yod kyi steng nas nyams bzhes mdzad nas/ mdun bskyed sa lugs ltar mdzad kyang 'gal ba ci yang med de/ sgrub thabs rnams la tshig brjod mi 'dra ba cung zad ma gtogs lam gyi spyi mi 'dra ba med pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang brgyud 'debs dang*/ phud mchod skabs bla ma brgyud pa'i stod 'dra yang*/ smad rang gis byin rlabs gang las thob pa dang sbrel lugs shes par bya dgos so// dri ba bcu dgu pa/ sātstsha 'debs rgyu 'di'i sngon gyi byung srol gang lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ sātstsha zhes pa 'di dbus pa blo gsal sogs kyis dam pa'i gzugs brnyan du bsgyur ba yod la/ yang na mchod rten dang sātstsha gcig tu byas pa ltar na/ legs sbyar skad du stu sya dang*/ tsai tya zhes pa ltar na bstod bya'am bsod nams bsags bya'i yul du'ang bshad pa yod la/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud las/

mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyang ba'i skabs nas/ ga bur dri dang bsgos pa yis// 'jim pa dang ni bsres nas kyang*// zhes dang*/ de yi ming nas smos nas ni// gur gum bzang pos sngags bris la// zhes dang*/ gzugs su bya ba'am yang na ni// mchod rten gyis ni lhar byas la// zhes dang*/ rim gyis 'bum ni tshang tsam du// mchod rten la ni rab tu bya// sdig can sdig ni zad bya'i phyir// bye ba snyed ni tshang bar bya// zhes dang*/ gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam lnga// yang na brgya rtsa brgyad bar du// sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas kyang*// 'bum phrag nyis brgya'i bar du bzlas// zhes sogs 'brang ba de nyid la rtsa ba'i rig pa nyis 'bum bzla ba sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams kyi gseb tshag tu'ang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la'ang mdo 'don pa dang sātstsha gdab pa zhes 'byung ba dang*/ sātstsha'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa sogs kyis mdzad pa las 'byung ba ltar dang*/ mchod rten dang sātstsha gcig bar byas pa'i phan yon rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa las 'byung ba dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis nyin zhag phrug cig gi chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa'i skabs nas/ 'bi 'bi dang*/ rgyar gzhug pa dang*/ rgya nas dbyung ba dang*/ gzungs 'bul ba/ rab gnas bya ba rnams 'byung ba ltar/ 'dis ni sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ 'chi ba bslu ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal pos/ sngags kyis 'jim pa la byin gyis brlabs nas/ de la sātstsha btab pas/ 'jim pa de la rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i skye ba thob sogs gsungs pa 'ga' zhig kho bos byas pa'i sātstsha 'debs pa'i cho ga sogs las 'byung bar gzigs pas gsal lo// dri ba nyi shu pa/ jo dar gyi byung khungs yang ji ltar lags/

jo dar klung rta sogs btags dus dar yu la oṃ hūm̐ sogs gnyis po gang nas btags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ 'di la byung khungs dang phan yon sogs bshad pa ma nges kyang*/ yig drug sogs sngags byin rlabs can rnams par la brgyabs nas rab gnas byas la/ khang steng sogs su ba dan byas nas btsugs pa de la rlung gis phog pa'am ma phog kyang gzungs sngags kyi nus pas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa sogs kyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ de dag gis nyer 'tshe mi nus pa sogs kyi phan yon 'byung ba ni/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs dang mtshungs pa tsam du go ba lags/ de dag gi lung thag yu ba la oṃ phog pa byas na rlung gi mi bskyod pa'i skabs sogs su sngags mgo mjug mi log pa sogs dang*/ klog pa na'ang dang por oṃ nas klog dgos pa sogs kyis 'thad par sems so// dri ba nyer gcig pa/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad nang nas zho dang dūr ba ma gtogs pa'i 'byung khungs gang lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ bkra shis rdzas kyi me long ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i skabs su gzugs khams nas 'ongs pa'i gzugs kyi lha mos me long gi mchod pa phul ba na/ de nyid ston pas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa zhig dang*/ glang chen sa srungs kyis gi wang phul ba zhes pa 'di ni dus nam zhig phul ba sogs de sngon yid la ma nges kyang*/ rgya gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar na/ gsung rab gzhan gyi gseb tshag nas 'byung ba zhig yin dgos te/ glang po che sa srungs ni glang g.yog lnga brgya dang bcas te lha ma yin gyi brag bya skyibs sogs sdod gnas mang po yod pas/ 'khor gyi glang chen gzhan shi ba'i gi wang yod pa gor ma chag ston pas 'dzam gling kun tu 'chag pa'i skabs sam dus gzhan du yang rung ste/ ston pa nye phyogs su byon pa na sa srungs kyis gi wang phul ba nad zhi byed shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa yin dgos te/

dper na/ ston pa mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab tu byon pa'i skabs su n+ya gro dha'i nags 'dabs nas/ glang chen gyis shing n+ya gro dha'i yal 'dab kyis ston pa'i sku la grib bsil g.yab cing rjes su 'brangs nas/ tshur log pa na seng ges bsad pa ston pa'i mthus lhar skyes te ston pa'i drung du 'ongs nas bden pa mthong ba lta bu'o// zho ni legs skyes mas ba nyis stong lnga brgya'i 'o ma nying khur byas pa bskol ba'i tshe na'ang rlangs pa las bkra shis rtags sogs shar ba'i lo rgyus yod pa ltar phul bas ston pa'i sku gser gyi mdog can du gsal bar byung ba dang*/ rtswa dūr ba ni rtswa 'tshong bkra shis las rtswa bslang ste/ byang chub shing drung du bting pa der bzhugs nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phul ba'ang dus nges pa ma rnyed kyang*/ tshangs pa nyid ston pa'i drung du lan du mar 'ongs pa na/ phyag stong pa min pa'i ched du phyag rten phul ba dang*/ brgya byin gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba gsol ba 'debs rten du phul ba dang*/ li khri ni bram ze skar rgyal gyi bu zhes pa ni/ shā ri'i bu rab tu ma byung ba'i gong tsam na ston pa dang por mjal ba'i phyag rten byas pa'am/ phyis su ston pa'i zhabs las sku mtshal babs pa'i skabs las phan byed kyi rdzas su phul ba yin las che/ yungs kar ni ston pa la bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong sogs kyis lhags pa na/ theg pa thun mong ba ltar na byams snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang*/ nang gsang sngags ltar na de skabs su gshin rje gshed kyi skur sprul pa'i skabs lta bu'am/ dus gzhan du'ang bdud sde'i co 'dri cho 'phrul mang po bstan pa'i skabs su bsgrubs pa'i yungs kar phul ba ste/ de rnams phul ba na ston pas rdo rje'i rigs su byin gyis brlabs pa phyag na rdo rjes thogs te des kyang bgegs zhi bar byed pa yin nam snyam pa tsam las/

dus 'di dang 'di zhes nges gsal byed rgyu ma byung yang*/ slar kho bo'i lta byed kyi dbang po gsal ba byung na bka' dgongs 'grel gang rung nas 'byung ba 'bul rtsis lags mod/ spyir da lta'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal da ltar mjal ba 'di tsam du ma zad/ 'phags pa'i yul nas da dung bod du 'gyur ma thub pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos mang du yod pa rgya bod kyi slob dpon mkhas pa mang pos bshad pa ltar na/ rnyed du yod pa'i nges pa'ang ma mchis lags/ dri ba nyer gnyis pa/ ri khrus lta bu la 'don bya bsgrigs rim lha khrus ltar byed 'dug pas ji ltar dgos lags/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan ni/ ri khrus zhes bya ba 'di sa bdag dang gzhi bdag rnams la sa rko rdo brlog sogs dang thab gzhob gsur sogs mi gtsang ba btang bas/ de dag rnams mi mgu ba dang*/ dme 'khon sogs grib kyis phog pa sbyong ba'i ched du/ khrus kyis sbyang ba lta bu yin pa 'dra bas/ de la slob dpon gzhan dag gis ji ltar mdzad kyin yod pa ma nges kyang*/ kho bo cag la gzhan gyis de 'dra dgos tshul byung ba na/ rnam 'joms dang*/ dme brtsegs sogs bum chu nus ldan du bsgrubs pa yod pa'i tshe/ thog mar sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs can rnams la lha khrus zhus pa'i bum chu bum par blugs pa khang steng sogs su khyer la/ thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha gang yin gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ ngag tu rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ ljongs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir mnga' bsgyur ba'i sa bdag yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i zo dor gnyan po che ge mo zhes bya ba/ mched dang rigs sras btsun mo blon 'bangs 'khor dang yang 'khor du bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang mdo stod mdo smad kyi ljongs kho ra khor yug gi sa chu rdo shing gnyan pa rnams la gnas pa rnams dang*/

khyad par phog thug 'khon grib sogs kyi nyes pas phog pa thams cad 'dir dag byed khrus kyi cho ga'i mgron 'dir skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir 'dus shing*/ khrus kyi bya ba ma grub kyi bar du 'khod par gyur cig sarba bhū mi pa ti lo ka pa la ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas thams cad 'dus nas khor yug kun du 'khod par bsams la/ las kyi rdo rjes me long dang khrus bum thogs te/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rdo rje dril bu thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyang mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yi legs bsgos chu'i// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ tshul khrims ྾ khrims 'chal྾ tshul khrims dri yi྾ khrus legs sogs sngags dang*/ de bzhin du bzod pa nas shes rab kyi bar dang*/ chu bo drug gi sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang bcas pa'i mthar/ rnam 'joms dme brtsegs gang rung gi sngags brjod cing*/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad sogs nas/ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na sarba pā paṃ bhyaḥsogs brjod pas kyang rung ngo*// yang rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba rdo rje dang bcas pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad byab par bsams la/ rnam 'joms kyi nye snying*/ dme brtsegs kyi sngags gang rung gi mjug tu gzhi bdag sogs kyi mthar a pa nā ya swā hās byab/ yang de dag gi sgo gsum la phyin chad bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir sngags gnyis gang rung gi mjug tu/

gzhi bdag sogs dang rakṣa rakṣa sogs kyis bsrung*/ me tog thogs te shis pa brjod pa ni/ nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas gtams pa'i tshogs dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bkra shis kyi cho ga byas par mos shig rdor dril me tog dang bcas te/ gang las ser sna sogs nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces brjod do// bsdu na de tsam gyis chog par byas nas dge ba bsngo bar bya'o// spro na/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa phog na phan yon shin tu che bas de ltar byas na 'di skad brjod de/ slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam theg pa chen po'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir seng ge'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskor ba ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ theg pa chen po'i dam chos glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa lta bur bzhugs par bsam pa ni chos dkon mchog theg pa chen po'i phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs par bsam pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ zhes brjod pas thams cad kyis rjes zlos byed par bsams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gzhi bdag gnas bdag sa bdag gi rigs su gtogs pa rnams dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum brjod pas de rnams kyi rgyud la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa skyes par bsam/

slar yang bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i nas dgongs su gsol gyi bar sngar bzhin dang*/ bdag cag gzhi bdag gnas bdag sa bdag gi rigs su gtogs pa rnams dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de dag gi ni bslab pa la// rim pa bzhin du gnas par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byang sdom skyes pa de la rang dga' ba bsgom pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// 'byung po'i srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gi ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog pa mi 'gyur de ltar bya// zhes lan gcig brjod/ gzhan dga' ba bsgom du bcug pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ byang chub sems ni rin po che sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs brjod do// gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khrus gtsang mgron du gang lhags pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ zhes pas rang rang gnas su song bar bsam zhing*/

dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid sogs kyis smon lam gang shes gdab bo// zhes pa 'di tsam byas pas 'byung po thams cad byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di// sems can kun gyi legs thob na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyur 'gyur zhes// mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba nges so snyam du sems so// de rnams kyis gtsug lag kun la dpyod pa'i blo gros rmad byung mchog sprul dam pa nas dri tshig phebs pa rnams kyi gsung lan rags bsdus phul ba lags so// 'dir smras pa/ kun mkhyen zhal gyi chu skyes grol ba las// tshangs dbyangs rkang drug glu yis bstan pa la// mkhas pa'i las byed mchog tu lung bstan pa// kun dga' bzang po rgyal tshab rim byon gyi// phrin las cho ga'i skabs kyi dogs gnas dang*// kha cig bab col spyod pa rung ngam zhes// bka' 'dri yi ge'i pho nyas 'phrin shod pa// rin chen skyes bzang dang bcas sug par son// kun dga'i chos la blo rab brtan pa rnams// dag dang ma dag dpyod kyi rmongs pas min// 'o ma chu dang 'dres pa ngang pa yis// 'byed kyis skye bo gzhan gyis 'dres mar spyod// gang tshe mthong thos rig pa'i brgya byin gyi// mdzub rtses zlos gar dkar 'jam zla ba'i ngos// bka' lan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i ri bong gzugs// dpyod ldan 'dren byed gtod pa'i gzigs mor phul// tshig nyung don gsal brjod pa'i ya mtshan dpe// nga la yod snyam daṇḍi'i gzhung bzang khyod// rgyags pa mi 'tshal chos rgyal dge dbang gi /rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod des kyang sgrun gyis dogs// 'di bris dge bas dad sgrol e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang bshad sgrub phyogs bral song ba'i mtha'// nyin mtshan sgron ma zung gis 'od bkye bas// 'tshol ba byed snyam nyid du rgyas gyur cig

/sngos bsags bsod nams chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i// lus can kunaṃ dgaṃ' bskyed pa'i 'od dkar can// bstan srid bde 'byung do ker rab tu brtan// phrin las snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /ces som nyi'i gnas kyi gsung lan dbang po'i zla ris zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gra 'ur grags pa'i dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor yangs par mnga' bsgyur ba'i sa skyong chen po'i rigs su skyes pa'i phyi nang gtsug lag dpyod pa'i dbang phyug sprul sku kun dga' rab brtan pa nas/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gi spyod tshul la brtags pa'i bka'i glegs bu snga phyir phebs pa/ gsung lan 'gor med du 'bul dgos mchis na'ang*/ kho bo'i lta byed dbang po'i sgrib g.yogs je gsal du 'gro ba'i re ba dang*/ dgos skabs kyi brel g.yeng 'ga' zhig gis 'gyangs tsam song yang*/ da lam bstan don mdzad pa rmad byung gi bka' lan stong pa'i mkha' la bos bzhin lan med du lus na mi rung snyam nas rab byung me zla'i nang gsel lcags khams yos bu'i bgrang gzhi'i zhag gi phung po khrums kyi dga' mas nya ba'i tshes dge bar/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab rgan las thos kyis bsrungs pa'i bsti gnas su bris nas phul ba lags so// ka lyā ṇa bi dza yaṃ bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
